title: Alexander the Great
subtitle: King of Macedon
bodyText: King of Macedon from 336 to 323 BCE, Alexander overthrew the Persian Empire and led his army into India. His conquests reshaped the ancient world and opened the Hellenistic age.

title: Camp Runner

title: Aristotle
subtitle: Philosopher of the Lyceum
bodyText: Aristotle made inquiry a life's work, examining logic, ethics, politics, and the living world. At the Lyceum in Athens, his investigations helped establish enduring ways to observe, classify, and reason.
